description.description: What the save was, in words, for the Change history view

undoes.description: The entry this one undoes, by file name

path.description: The file's path under the root, with / separators

from.description: The file's old path under the root, when the save moved it (R12), with / separators

hash.description: The file's audio hash (A2.3), which finds it when it has moved (A2.8)

fields.description: Each changed field's old value, by R4.1 field

new.description: Each changed field's value as written, by R4.1 field, which Undo checks the file against (R4.9.1)

cover.description: Present when the cover changed: the old cover, kept as history/images/<sha256>; null when there was none

new_cover.description: The cover written, by its sha256; null when it was removed

pictures.description: Present when the song's other pictures changed (R5.3): each it had but its front cover, its bytes kept as history/images/<sha256>

type.description: Its picture type, as ID3 and FLAC number them; null where the kind has none (MP4)

image.description: Its bytes' sha256, kept as history/images/<sha256>

new_pictures.description: The other pictures written, by their sha256 (none: removed)

image.description: For an image file the save wrote beside the songs (cover.jpg, R5.3): its old bytes, kept as history/images/<sha256>; null when there was none

new_image.description: The image file's bytes written, by their sha256; null when it was moved to the trash
